races.paceDynamic: Reciprocated is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the rail, likely setting a sustainable tempo without early pressure. Cape Ashizuri, Daizen, Anaisa and Awraad all show prominent tendencies but may settle just behind rather than challenge immediately. This creates a controlled pace scenario where the leaders can dictate without being harried early. The race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those with tactical pace, as they can position close enough to strike while avoiding the potential traffic issues that could hinder Daydreama from his hold-up style.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front End Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Reciprocated gets uncontested early lead and others settle behind
scenarios.body: The pace becomes very manageable allowing the front two to dominate, with those tracking closest best positioned to strike. Late closers find the steady tempo leaves them with too much to do from the rear.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle
scenarios.trigger: If multiple runners press forward creating more pressure on Reciprocated
scenarios.body: A faster tempo develops as 4-5 horses race prominently, setting up the race for a strong closer or those who can quicken best late. The increased pace particularly suits those with finishing kick from mid-division.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Even Pace Distribution
scenarios.trigger: If field spreads out evenly with modest early pace and gradual acceleration
scenarios.body: The race becomes a test of pure ability over tactics, favouring those in peak form regardless of position. Class and current condition become the primary factors rather than running style.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Early Speed Duel
scenarios.trigger: If Cape Ashizuri or others challenge Reciprocated for early lead
scenarios.body: A genuine speed battle develops up front, compromising the leaders and creating perfect conditions for closers. The strong early pace particularly benefits Daydreama's hold-up style.

watchPoints.text: Reciprocated getting loose on the lead unchallenged - could prove unstoppable if allowed easy fractions
Daydreama's draw and ability to secure clear racing room from hold-up position in small field
Cape Ashizuri and Awraad both returning from lengthy breaks - market support crucial for fitness assessment
Early positioning of multiple prominent runners - whether they press forward or settle behind Reciprocated
Jockey tactics on Alaminos given stable form and lengthy absence - how aggressive Kevin Stott rides

races.paceDynamic: Antrim, Romieu, and Sunriseontheboyne will establish the early gallop, with three confirmed front-runners creating genuine pace pressure from the start. The sustained tempo over 1m2f at Pontefract will test stamina reserves, particularly as the leaders battle for position through the middle stages. With strong pace guaranteed, the race sets up perfectly for hold-up horses to close late under reduced fractions. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up brigade who can capitalise on the fierce early gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders create honest fractions and weaken late
scenarios.body: The strong early pace will set up perfectly for closers like Flying Frontier and Marhaba Ghaiyyath who can pick off tired front-runners. The stamina test over 1m2f favours those conserving energy early.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Survives Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters can resist the challenges and kick clear
scenarios.body: Antrim or Romieu could use their early advantage to build an unassailable lead if rivals fail to close quickly enough. The winner would need superior fitness to withstand the early battle.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Perfectly Positioned
scenarios.trigger: If Insanity and Fireblade avoid the early speed battle but stay close
scenarios.body: Sitting just behind the leaders allows them to avoid the worst of the pace pressure while maintaining striking position. They can pounce when the leaders tire without using excessive energy.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders go too fast and all capitulate before the turn
scenarios.body: An unsustainably strong gallop could see all pace-setters struggle home, leaving the race to unfold at a crawl. This unlikely scenario would favour those with natural speed over pure stamina.

watchPoints.text: Antrim setting fierce fractions early could burn out his chances if he doesn't settle better than usual

races.paceDynamic: Yorkshire Glory will likely set the pace from the start given his recent front-running victories, but No Return could also go forward creating early pressure. The middle portion should see a steady tempo with the large field of hold-up horses (Newsreader, Great, Hectic, Azure Zain, Valentine Catcher, Wish This, Palmarian) tracking behind the early leaders. The final furlong will become a cavalry charge as the closers unleash, but the sustained pace should prevent a complete sit-and-sprint finish. This pace shape favours horses with prominent tactical speed who can avoid trouble and kick when it matters.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Yorkshire Glory Maintains Momentum
scenarios.trigger: If Yorkshire Glory translates his all-weather dominance to turf without losing his tactical edge.
scenarios.body: His front-running style suits the course configuration and his confidence is sky-high after nine winter wins. The step up in grade may not stop his relentless galloping style on this sharp track.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes honest enough to set up the large contingent of closers.
scenarios.body: Newsreader and Great both have the class to capitalize on a strong pace, while Hectic's Ripon win shows he can find the gaps when needed. The numbers favour the patient tactics with so many sharing this approach.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If No Return and Hi Lord can exploit their forward positions without getting embroiled in early speed.
scenarios.body: These two can sit just behind Yorkshire Glory and have first run on the field, avoiding the traffic that often snares the hold-up horses. Their tactical positions give them the jump on rivals when the sprint begins.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the market leaders fail to handle the return to turf or the competitive handicap company.
scenarios.body: Valentine Catcher or Wish This could exploit a collapse in market confidence, though both need significant improvement from recent efforts. The competitive nature of handicaps can produce surprise results when class horses underperform.

watchPoints.text: Yorkshire Glory's turf debut after nine all-weather wins - any signs of discomfort on the surface could end his streak immediately
Newsreader returning after 194 days off - watch for any ring rustiness or fitness issues in the preliminaries
Azure Zain's behavior after hanging left badly on his February return - any repeat of that wayward tendency
The pace battle between Yorkshire Glory and No Return in the opening two furlongs will determine the race shape
How quickly the hold-up horses can get into contention from the three-furlong pole with such a large field sharing similar tactics

races.paceDynamic: Royal Deeside will take the field along at a sustainable gallop over this marathon trip, with Achnamara, Charlie Darling, Home And Dry and Capone likely to track him in the early stages. The moderate early tempo will allow the large contingent of hold-up horses to settle well before the race develops into a stamina test from the 3f pole. With only one confirmed front-runner and multiple hold-up performers including Different Drum, Ebendi, Lillistar, Lady Phoebe, Edwardtheninth, Lion City and Izakaya, this sets up perfectly for strong stayers who can quicken off a steady gallop. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses with proven stamina who can deliver their effort late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate throughout allowing the back-markers time to organise
scenarios.body: The large group of hold-up performers get perfectly positioned to unleash their finishing kicks, with the strongest stayers prevailing in a cavalry charge finish. Royal Deeside's modest early pace plays directly into their hands.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Royal Deeside sets genuine fractions and the hold-up brigade get caught flat-footed
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes more testing than expected, allowing a horse tracking the leader to strike with a well-timed move. Achnamara or Charlie Darling can capitalise on their forward positions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Stays On
scenarios.trigger: If Royal Deeside gets an uncontested lead and maintains strong stamina reserves
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows Royal Deeside to dictate terms completely, quickening off his own tempo to hold the late challengers at bay. His recent hurdles form suggests the engine is still there.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Upset From Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a true staying test and class proves less important than stamina
scenarios.body: The extreme distance brings out hidden reserves in a lightly-weighted runner who has been underestimated by the handicapper. Edwardtheninth's AW form hints at untapped potential over this trip.

watchPoints.text: Royal Deeside could get too easy a lead if the field allows him uncontested fractions, making him very dangerous late on
Different Drum's hurdles win 17 days ago suggests peak fitness but needs to prove that form translates back to Flat racing
Achnamara represents Philip Kirby who has won two of the last six runnings of this specific race, suggesting stable targets this prize
Lady Phoebe returns from 205 days off which creates fitness doubts over this extreme distance despite her competitive handicap mark
Multiple hold-up horses including Lillistar, Edwardtheninth and Izakaya could get in each other's way if they all deliver finishing kicks simultaneously

races.paceDynamic: Tanjen is the sole confirmed front-runner and will look to dictate from the rail with David Allan likely to inject early pace to establish position. Fuji Mountain, Betweenthesticks and Filly's Last Lady can press from prominent spots, but none are natural speed horses who will challenge Tanjen's early supremacy. The lack of pace pressure means Tanjen can control fractions through steady early splits before the field closes late. This controlled tempo strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce sustained finishes, with the numerous closers like Speeding Bullet, Military Girl and Sergeant Mayer positioned to strike.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Tanjen dictates uncontested fractions through the first two furlongs
scenarios.body: The lack of early speed allows patient tactics to flourish as closers get ideal positioning for late strikes. Hold-up horses can unleash telling finishes in the final furlong when the early leader wilts.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tanjen Wire-to-Wire Success
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runner maintains his kick when challenged and the pace stays honest
scenarios.body: Tanjen's class advantage shows as he repels late challengers having controlled the race shape from flagfall. His previous course form and tactical advantage prove decisive against this moderate handicap field.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Capitalize
scenarios.trigger: If Fuji Mountain or Betweenthesticks can press Tanjen and create faster fractions
scenarios.body: The increased pace sets up perfectly for horses tracking just behind the leaders who avoid the worst of the speed duel. These prominent runners can strike in the final quarter-mile as both leaders and hold-up horses struggle.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If Tanjen goes too slowly and creates a bunched sprint finish
scenarios.body: The pedestrian early tempo results in a cavalry charge where any horse with a turn of foot can win regardless of position. Fresh horses returning from breaks can capitalize on the even-pace scenario.
